one_month_reasoning: No scheduled company catalyst inside the window: Q3 2026 results are expected 2026-11-05 (source 8), after the 2026-11-01 horizon (a Sunday, so the effective print is the 2026-10-30 close). Q3 guidance was revenue $304-307M (+32-34%) so any pre-announcement risk is low. The stock rose ~25% in September off a $101.7 low (source 7) and CEO 10b5-1 sales continue (source 3), so short-term momentum and reversal roughly cancel out. Pre-earnings run-ups in AI-infrastructure names are common, but I don't treat that as a strong edge. I therefore use a near-symmetric lognormal centred on $140 with monthly sigma ~22% (82%/3.5 ≈ 23%), shading P(>=spot) to 0.495.

fair_value.method: Blend of three peer-benchmarked multiples applied to horizon-NTM (CY2028E) numbers: EV/Sales 7.0x on $2.29B ($117), P/E 47x on $2.45 ($115) and EV/EBITDA 20x on $847M ($124), less ~$0.8B net debt incl. leases, over ~130M diluted shares. Weighted 0.4/0.3/0.3 = ~$118.

methods.name: EV/sales
methods.inputs: CY2028E revenue $2.29B x 7.0x = EV $16.0B; less net debt incl. leases $0.8B; /130M diluted shares

inputs_detail.derivation: Consensus $1.75-1.77B matches the CEO's 'exceed 50% growth in 2027' on FY26 guide $1.170-1.180B

Deceleration from 50% as the AI base enlarges. The 20MW of new capacity (~155MW total, late 2027, source 9) and RPO $894M with >3-yr life (source 1) support continued >25% growth. DDOG/SNOW/NET CY27 growth is 22-29% (source 4).

Peer CY2027 EV/Sales median 5.37x (range 3.6-33.4x). 7x sits above the neocloud/infra cluster (3.6-5.6x) because DOCN has positive adj. FCF and ~38% adj. EBITDA margins. It sits well below DDOG/SNOW/NET (15-33x) because it is a capital-intensive GPU business with lower gross margin.

Cash $767M and converts $921M at Q2 (source 1). $472M of 2030 notes was repurchased with equity (cash-neutral, source 2), leaving ~$449M of notes. Stockanalysis net debt of $1.21B incl. leases (source 4) implies ~$1.06B of lease liabilities, so net ≈ $0.74B today, rounded up for continued GPU leasing.
Q3 guide 126-127M diluted + ~2-3% SBC/convert dilution over 12 months; 116.9M basic after July offering
$1.84 x 1.33: 30% revenue growth with modest operating leverage, offset by rising lease D&A from capacity build (FY26 EPS guide $1.35-1.40 shows D&A drag)
Peer CY2027 P/E median 46.7x (8 profitable peers, range 14.5-207.8x). I use the median rather than a premium because DOCN's EPS growth (+26% in 2027) is near the peer median.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: CY2028E adj. EBITDA $847M (37% x $2.29B) x 20x = EV $16.9B; less $0.8B; /130M

inputs_detail.derivation: FY26 guide 38.5-39.5%, Q2 40%. Haircut ~2pts for a GPU/inference mix shift and new-capacity startup costs.

Derived forward EV/EBITDA for EBITDA-positive peers: CRWV 7.3x, ORCL 10.3x, AKAM 15.6x, NBIS 29.5x; median 13x. 20x sits inside the range. It is above ORCL/AKAM because DOCN grows 30-50% vs 16-35%, and above CRWV because CRWV carries $51.6B debt and negative FCF. It is below NBIS's 29.5x.

bear.story: AI-infrastructure de-rating plus an execution wobble. Inference ARR growth slows, one or more nine-figure commitments ramp late, and lease-funded capex pushes FCF near zero. Core SMB cloud keeps losing share to Hetzner/Vultr (HN migration threads, Similarweb traffic -8% m/m). 2027 growth guide comes in at 35-40% instead of 50%+, and the stock trades back to ~5x CY28 sales, near the infra-peer median.

base.story: DOCN delivers roughly 50% 2027 growth and guides 2028 to ~30%, with adj. EBITDA margin in the high-30s. The multiple compresses from ~10.5x to ~7-8x forward sales as growth normalises, and the earnings rise offsets that compression. The stock ends near today's price, a little above my $118 peer-bounded fair value because it still carries an AI-growth premium.

bull.story: Inference demand compounds (OpenRouter volumes and GPU rental prices keep firming), more nine-figure deals land, RPO passes $2B and 2028 growth is guided at 40%+. The market pays 10-12x forward sales, as NBIS-type neocloud names get today, and the stock retakes and exceeds the $187.50 high.

comps_summary.peer_range: All on a calendar-2027 basis (fiscal years ending Jan-2028 used as CY27; ORCL time-weighted FY27/FY28; IREN averaged FY27/FY28). P/E 14.5x-207.8x across 8 profitable peers (CRWV, NBIS, IREN are loss-making). Forward EV/EBITDA 7.3x-29.5x across 4 peers with meaningfully positive GAAP EBITDA (EV / TTM EBITDA scaled by CY27/TTM revenue, i.e. constant margin); NM for the rest because GAAP EBITDA is negative or near zero after SBC. EV/Sales CY27 3.6x-33.4x, median 5.37x.
comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: Today DOCN trades at ~76x CY27 P/E, ~28.5x CY27 EV/EBITDA (EV ~$18.5B incl. leases / ~$650M) and ~10.5x CY27 EV/Sales, above the peer median on every measure but inside the range. My fair value uses 47x P/E (the median), 20x EV/EBITDA (inside the range, above the 13x median) and 7.0x EV/Sales (above the 5.4x median), all applied to CY2028E.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: The modest EV/EBITDA and EV/Sales premiums rest on traits that should persist through the horizon. First, structurally faster revenue growth: 50% in 2027, backed by $894M of contracted RPO with >3-year life, vs a 16-35% median for profitable peers. Second, positive adj. FCF and a ~38% adj. EBITDA margin while CRWV, NBIS and IREN burn cash, plus a lighter balance sheet (leased GPUs; converts cut by $472M). The premium is capped well below the software peers (DDOG/SNOW/NET) because DOCN's capital intensity and GPU-rental gross margins are structurally lower. I add no premium on P/E. Sell-side outperform calls are not used as justification.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$85 the market would be pricing DOCN at ~5x CY27 EV/Sales and ~40x CY27 EPS, i.e. in line with the slower infra peers. That would most likely mean the 50%+ 2027 growth plan has broken: nine-figure AI commitments delayed or cancelled, RPO shrinking, or the core SMB cloud churning faster. Ordinary 80%-vol noise from $140 rarely holds there without a fundamental trigger.

reasoning: Facts: Q2'26 revenue $281M (+29%) and adj. EBITDA 40%. RPO is $894M (12x YoY). FY26 guide was raised to $1.17-1.18B, and the CEO targets >50% growth in 2027; consensus CY27 revenue is ~$1.76B and EPS $1.84. The July equity raise ($1.47B at $117.54) retired $472M of 2030 converts, leaving ~117M basic and ~127M diluted shares. Price path: $187.50 high in June, $101.7 low in early September, $140 now. Peer benchmarking on one calendar-2027 basis over 11 comps gives a median P/E of 46.7x, a median EV/Sales of 5.4x and a median forward EV/EBITDA of 13x among the 4 meaningful peers. At 76x / 10.5x / 28.5x, DOCN carries a full AI-growth premium. A peer-bounded valuation of horizon NTM numbers gives ~$118. Alternative-lane signals are mixed. Positive: GPU rental prices (H100/B200) rose month on month into September and Blackwell supply is reserved into 2027, which supports pricing for capacity holders; DOCN is hiring senior inference-kernel engineers; independent newsletters (Asymmetrical Bets, GritALPHA) are bullish on the RPO step-change. Negative: Similarweb shows digitalocean.com traffic down 8% m/m with rank slipping, a proxy for the legacy SMB funnel; Hacker News carried a top-voted 'migrate to Hetzner' thread and an Aug 24 control-panel outage; OpenRouter data put DOCN only 43rd of 88 inference providers by tokens, so inference scale is still small; insiders are steady 10b5-1 sellers. I find no prediction markets on DOCN-relevant events. Reddit and X could not be fetched (blocked), so sentiment there is unobserved. Distribution: a 3-scenario lognormal mixture (bear $75/25%, base $140/50%, bull $235/25%) gives a mean of ~$148 and a median just under spot, with fat tails consistent with 82% realised vol. P(>=140) = 0.49 reflects fair value below spot offset by strong fundamental momentum. Alternative-lane sources are 9 of 17 (53%). The rest are filings plus the peer-data pages the comps requirement needs, consolidated into single entries.
